hooks.command: Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Windows.Forms; [System.Windows.Forms.MessageBox]::Show('Claude Code needs your attention', 'Claude Code') | Out-Null

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { IFS= read -r f; case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx|*.mjs|*.cjs|*.json|*.css|*.scss) ./node_modules/.bin/prettier --ignore-unknown --write "$f";; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
